scope: Source/ordinary JSON readback only; no HF/NumPy import, NPZ decode, geometry/model/array construction, cost probe/pilot, solver/HP/JIT/render. No formal repository edits.

existing_thin_API_admission.solver_initialization: zero lift / undeformed fluctuation; original port_projection
existing_thin_API_admission.analysis_grid: native supplied HF-derived h0.5; not original LF-native grid
existing_thin_API_admission.single_case_batch_preflight: Single case is sufficient; no cross-case nonphysical description comparison issue

task_preservation.production_task: Create a new task JSON outside the closed preparation run; keep geometry identity/analysis_grid/all physical fields/path unchanged from verified h05 task. Change task_id/purpose/description (and parameter_origin only if clarifying text) to full exploratory forward cycle; remove construction-only wording. Preserve original prepared task bytes.

minimal_source_plan: Create one new single-case manifest pointing to the verified nested run geometry.json and a new production task; output under a new fine production stage. Reuse mechanical/chunk256/port_projection. Copy old settings exactly except explicitly approved controller time allowance.

Keep old W-API1 source/card/output frozen. Copy its already exercised worker to a new stage, replacing only stage/manifest/output-label/budget configuration and adding protocol expected_counts admission. Old worker currently hardcodes 4500/4560 and coarse stage/manifest; it cannot run fine as-is.

Preserve old observed force/tangent hooks and accepted-progress callback behavior; no new mechanics, tangent, solver or serializer implementation. A tiny checked-build delegate can compare the single constructed project.region_metadata counts to frozen actual M-PREP1 expected_counts before any force call.

Use existing unchanged CLI/main -> batch -> API -> one model -> one original solve -> one cached writer -> one summary. No old accepted seeds and no prepared-model loader. Preserve normal partial-return persistence; escaping resource errors preserve accepted_progress and already written output only.

At saved result admission compare counts against actual prepared model, geometry identity/source pins, actual observed call counts against solver bookkeeping, and new saved model arrays SHA to M-PREP1 declared model-array hash (nonphysical task strings do not affect arrays). Model JSON task-dependent hashes legitimately change.

Freeze current executed HF source closure as in original W-API1, fine geometry/task/manifest/new worker/unchanged launcher/card and M-PREP1 checked baseline before any new run; source-only AST and focused diff review suffice now. No mock/cost/pilot/scientific tests are proposed.

completion_rules.not_required: 24 total accepted states; coarse F340/T174; coarse trial counts; old reference qualification
completion_rules.required: success/path_completed/loading_peak/unload_endpoint plus exactly one is_original_target record for each original_target_index 0..23, matching target d and leg; preserve allowed additional bisection states
completion_rules.bisections: Retain existing max_bisections4 and minimum_increment .00625; internal line-search/backtracking/allowed bisection is original controller behavior, not wrapper retry
completion_rules.terminal_stop: One attempt, no extension/repair/retry/force; original terminal failure or resource escape closes card. Recoverable original trial errors remain under unchanged controller.
completion_rules.qualification: New fine production only; independent_reference/views not_provided, producer flags remain false. No contact/pressure/clamp/HF5/full-column/energy qualification.

proposed_resource_window.basis: Verified fine cell count is 4x coarse; if coarse nonlinear/kernel workload stayed equal, kernel_and_transfer2127.8602s x4 =8511.4409s, plus assembly/solve/cache persistence. This arithmetic is only a planning allowance basis. 14400 controller permits unmeasured fine iteration/conditioning growth, 600 helper headroom for imports/persistence/hash checks, 60 outer terminal headroom.
caveats: Fine sparse LU fill/factorization, iteration counts, trial rejection/bisection and active medium distortion are unmeasured and can grow nonlinearly. Coarse sparse_solve6.1365s does not predict fine sparse_solve.
Prepared model17.94s/187662336B tree peak establishes construction only, not force/tangent/solver/cache peak memory. Sampled8GiB remains a limit, not a proven memory requirement.
Synchronous numerical calls observe cooperative limits on return; no OS hard memory cap or force termination.
Do not borrow unused M-PREP1 seconds or silently preserve coarse4500 resource cap; future proposed allowance must be stated in a new card.

later_dependencies: Only after production terminal and saved cache readback, prepare fine independent reference for actual accepted states with its own concrete budget. Old coarse48HP does not cover fine data.
Prepare saved geometry/node-force observations and actual deformation/force/J/Hu views as a separately bounded step. No new visual render in production.

Then compare matched original d and loading/unloading leg across h1/h05. Additional fine bisection states do not alter original-target matching. Two grids report sensitivity, not asymptotic convergence.

actual_source_changes: single model-count admission before any force; original observed instrumentation retained
saved model/source bindings and original-target full-cycle completion preserving bisection states
